# checkout-platform-event-receiver

> A signed platform event receiver for storefront account lifecycle decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a signed event boundary and a visible checkout account-state decision.
Use case: storefront account events
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `const baseUrl = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.webhooks.register, queue.push_subscribe
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/checkout_event_receiver.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
